title: Fixed-scale comparison of the blow-up integrals of A ⊆ B (Simon Ch. 3, proof of 1.6 "⇒")
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let A ⊆ B ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel sets, x ∈ ℝ^P, r > 0 and R, C ∈ ℝ. Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be continuous with |f(y)| ≤ C for every y and f(y) = 0 for every y ∉ closedBall(0, R). Write η = blowUpMap x r, so η(z) = r⁻¹·(z − x) (SimonGMT Chapter03), and μ = μHE[n]. If μ(η(B) ∩ closedBall(0, R)) < ∞, then |∫_{η(B)} f dμ − ∫_{η(A)} f dμ| ≤ C · μ(η(B ∖ A) ∩ closedBall(0, R)). The measure on the right is finite and is converted to a real number by ENNReal.toReal.
